lines.caption: Vigil, warning a borrower: their MUSD loan just slipped below its alert line.
On Mezo, there are two ways to lose your Bitcoin.
And redemption: Mezo takes BTC from the lowest-ratio loans first, even healthy ones. Most borrowers never see it coming.
Vigil watches both. Send it your Mezo address.
Every minute it reads every loan on Mezo: your liquidation price, your place in the redemption queue, and how long interest alone takes to hurt you.
The same view on the web: a real loan on Mezo testnet, read live.
For the bad night, set up a rescue: keep a MUSD reserve, pick a trigger, and sign Mezo's own repay message once.
Mezo checks that signature itself, so Vigil can't change the amount, the loan or the deadline.
On-chain: when this test loan crossed its trigger, Vigil's keeper submitted the rescue on its own.
300 MUSD repaid from the reserve. Ratio 130.9% → 148.8%.
It refuses what it should: a rescue above the trigger, and a signature with a changed amount, which Mezo rejects itself.
No owner. Verified source. 12 fork tests against Mezo's real contracts.
Vigil: a guard for MUSD loans on Mezo. Try it on Telegram today.
